title: DaKanji krad file
description: The radicals of every kanji of a dakanji-radicals archive, in a file whose name contains `krad` (e.g. kradfile.json). Keys other than the ones below are ignored.

version.description: Version of the source data, not read.

kanji.description: Maps every kanji to its radicals. Every radical must be a radical of the radk file (after DaLang's lookup of variant forms), the import fails otherwise. Empty strings and spaces are skipped.
